name: What are common storage solutions for a finished garage?

mainEntity.name: What are common storage solutions for a finished garage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common storage solutions for finished garages include custom cabinetry, wall-mounted shelving, overhead storage racks, and pegboard or slatwall systems. Custom cabinets offer a clean, built-in look and hide clutter. Shelving and overhead racks maximize vertical space. Pegboard and slatwall provide flexible organization for tools and smaller items, keeping the floor clear.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular garage storage includes custom cabinetry, wall shelves, overhead racks, and pegboard systems to maximize space and organization.
